paper_id: Xi et al. - 2009 - Run to Potential Sweep Coverage in Wireless Sensor Networks
title: Run to Potential: Sweep Coverage in Wireless Sensor Networks
motivation: Full coverage and barrier coverage incur prohibitive cost in large-scale sparse sensor networks for applications like farming monitoring
problem_framing: Define sweep coverage for dynamic POIs where mobile nodes must retrieve data within delay bound T, requiring no fixed rendezvous points
key_insight: Build virtual 3D potential field where POIs form peaks; mobile nodes climb gradients toward POIs using only local neighbor information
method_signature: Potential-guided distributed sweep algorithm with anti-collision agents and virtual 3D gradient map
evaluation_criteria: Average sweep delay (time to retrieve POI data) and average moving distance per mobile node
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Sweep delay with 26 nodes is a bit larger than bound because mobile nodes follow marked paths not strict lines; worse than DSweep-global which assumes global information
evidence_for_taste: is a bit larger than the bound
much smaller than that of naive method
thinking_moves: 先证理论下界再设计算法
把导航问题转成势场爬山问题
用coupon collector模型推导节点需求
通过agent预标记路径解决碰撞问题
